§6Kerosene§f

§aJetpacks, rockets, Soyuz launches. If it flies, it runs on kerosene.§f

Kerosene is an aviation-grade fuel providing §e2.56 MTU§f and §e3.85 MHE§f per bucket. Obtained by fractioning §bLight Oil§f or cracking §bDiesel§f.

§6Production§f:
§b• From Light Oil§f: §e100mB§f → §e40mB§f Diesel + §e60mB§f Kerosene.
§b• From Vacuum Light Oil§f: §e100mB§f → §e70mB§f Kerosene + §e30mB§f Reformate Gas.
§b• From Cracked Light Oil§f: §e100mB§f → §e70mB§f Kerosene + §e30mB§f Petroleum Gas.
§b• Cracking Tower§f: §e100mB§f Diesel + Steam → §e40mB§f Kerosene.

§6Key Uses§f:
§b• Jetpacks§f: 3 of 4 types run on kerosene (up to §e16,000mB§f each).
§b• Soyuz Launch§f: Requires §e128,000mB§f.
§b• Jet Fuel§f: §e100mB§f Reformate + §e900mB§f Kerosene → §e1,000mB§f.
§b• BF Rocket Fuel§f: §e6,000mB§f + §e1× Balefire Shard§f.
§b• NITAN Super Fuel§f: §e600mB§f + Mercury + Nitanium Blend.

§ePS:§f Kerosene is the only fuel for advanced transportation. Always keep a stock for refueling. The §bChainsaw§f also accepts it.
